title: bromus arvensis splendens
intro: Bromus arvensis splendens, commonly known as golden oat grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is known to have various health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and lower cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of golden oat grass include its use as a natural remedy for insomnia, anxiety, and stress relief, due to its sedative and anti-anxiety properties. The bioactive constituents of Bromus arvensis splendens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
